thread:
carmen_cs: Kicking off Willow onboarding. High-level sprint-0 (10 days) goals: 1) wire Redwood Hosted into their ticket triage flow, 2) run a 10-sample latency/cost benchmark, 3) Console runbook training for Willow CSMs. Who takes which lane?

leo_pm: I'll be the Willow PM contact. Prefer weekly sync Mon 11am PT. I'll share their SRE contact (Vikram) and infra constraints after this.

vikram_sre: Vikram (Willow SRE) here. We require EU data residency and are likely to need Dedicated or a regional-hosted fallback. Also need webhook TLS + IP allowlist.

nina_success: I'll own acceptance criteria. Draft: (a) 95th percentile latency <350ms on staging for the sample set, (b) end-to-end ticket flow validated in staging, (c) CSMs complete Console runbook checklist. If go-live misses Day 30, mark renewal risk and escalate.

alex_se: I'll take model selection + integration support. Need anonymized ticket samples (10) and staging key. Will provide a smoke-test curl and a minimal Node example.

onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist: /docs/onboarding/willow-template. Reminder: fill security questionnaire for EU residency step.

carmen_cs: Action items: 1) leo to intro Vikram + infra by EOD, 2) Willow to provide 10 anon tickets + webhook payload by Day 2, 3) alex to share smoke tests Day 1-2, 4) nina to post acceptance tests Day 2, 5) I'll create sprint board and invite owners today.

leo_pm: Intro sent. Also sharing a short list of compliance contacts. Will export 10 anonymized tickets to the shared folder by tomorrow EOD.

vikram_sre: Opening internal ticket for IP allowlist/peering. ETA 48h for review. If peering delayed, we accept a proxy tunnel approach.

alex_se: Quick curl smoke test (share with their engs):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize ticket: <body>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

nina_success: I'll validate routing and fallback options for EU by tomorrow and post cost delta if Dedicated is required.

carmen_cs: Scheduling first sync Mon 11am PT. Small ask: after initial setup (48h), get feedback from Willow CSMs on the Console runbook so we can iterate. :thumbsup:

leo_pm: Confirmed, CSMs will join the runbook session. Excited to get started.

(onboarding thread closed)
